comment: No source is published for this plugin, version 2.0.1. The maker's manual at PathSetManuals agrees with the entry everywhere it was checked. Param ranges: Reset Count 1 to 65 with a default of 8, Reset Column a switch of 0 to 7 with the labels Col 1, Col 2, Col 3, Col 4, Current Col, Next Col, Previous Col, Random Col, Arrow Intensity a switch of 1 to 3 with the labels No Arrows, Left Arrows, All Arrows and a default of 2, Lowest CV -10 to 10 defaulting to -3 and Highest CV -10 to 10 defaulting to 3. Each slider is a CVQuantity running 0 to 1 with a default of 0.5, whose displayed value is lowest + value × (highest − lowest) quantized. At the top of Reset Count the tooltip reads Infinty, a spelling mistake; the panel prints OFF under the knob. The maker's convention holds here: every trigger jack on the module, clock, reset and the sixteen node inputs alike, is a Schmitt trigger taking high at 2V and low at 0.1V. The other half of that convention does not apply, since GlassShard has no knob-plus-attenuverter CV inputs at all. Two of the three Toggle Global Effect params, 65 and 66, have no widget position and no click can reach them, so they are left untagged; only param 64 is placed on the panel. The census gives every node input the same position and every slider of a given number the same position, because those widgets are children of a per-node container rather than of the panel; the tags are by index and are unaffected, but a position-based lookup will not tell nodes apart. The number and placement of sliders, arrows and modifiers changes with each weekly configuration, so no line here names a particular modifier.
